lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Berry egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, toast and berries
dishes.method: Toast the bread, soft-scramble the eggs in a pan, and serve with the berries on the side.
dishes.why: A small warm breakfast keeps the day started and gives everyone a proper protein anchor without extra faff.

dishes.name: Plain egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, toast and berries
dishes.method: Toast the bread, scramble the eggs, and serve with the berries on the side.
dishes.why: A small warm breakfast keeps the day started while staying easy enough for a busy weekday.

dishes.name: Big berry egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, toast and berries
dishes.method: Toast the bread, fry the eggs, and serve with extra berries on the side.
dishes.why: A small warm breakfast with a fuller protein anchor fits the household’s first meal without making it fussy.

dishes.name: Chicken pasta bowls
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and pasta
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, vegetables and pasta in a pan with a squeeze of lemon, then finish with parsley.
dishes.why: A loud vegetable, a proper protein and a starch that suits training make a solid lunch with one cooking session doing the work.

dishes.name: Chicken pasta bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and pasta
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, vegetables and pasta together, then finish with lemon.
dishes.why: A simple reheated bowl keeps lunch efficient and still puts a real protein at the centre.

dishes.name: Chicken pasta plate
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and pasta
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, vegetables and pasta in a pan, then brighten with lemon and parsley.
dishes.why: A generous plate of chicken, vegetables and pasta gives the table an easy lunch with the vegetable front and centre.

dishes.name: Lentil toast lunch
dishes.title: Lentil tomato sauce, spinach and toast
dishes.method: Warm the lentil tomato sauce in a pan, wilt the spinach into it, and toast the bread on the side.
dishes.why: It uses a batch that is ready in time for Thursday and keeps a full protein food at the centre without needing the oven.

dishes.name: Lentil toast lunch
dishes.title: Lentil tomato sauce, spinach and toast
dishes.method: Warm the lentil tomato sauce in a pan, wilt the spinach into it, and toast the bread on the side.
dishes.why: It is quick, warm and steady on a day when the kitchen setup is awkward.

dishes.name: Herby chicken dinner
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice and vegetables in a pan with a little water, then finish with lemon.
dishes.why: The first dinner keeps a warm element on the plate and pushes the starch to the training day without extra cooking.

dishes.name: Herby chicken dinner
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice and vegetables together, then finish with lemon.
dishes.why: It is a straightforward dinner that stays warm, uses one batch and keeps the plate readable.

dishes.name: Courgette frittata and toast
dishes.title: Courgettes, eggs and toast
dishes.method: Cook the courgettes in a pan, add the beaten eggs and cheddar, and finish under a lid; toast the bread alongside.
dishes.why: Thursday needs something cooked without relying on the broken oven door, and this still gives a proper protein anchor.

dishes.name: Courgette egg toast
dishes.title: Courgettes, eggs and toast
dishes.method: Cook the courgette in a pan, add the eggs and cheddar, and serve with toast.
dishes.why: A straightforward cooked breakfast works around the oven issue and keeps the morning warm.

dishes.name: Bean and pepper wraps
dishes.title: Black beans, peppers and wraps
dishes.method: Warm the beans and sweetcorn in a pan with the peppers, then fill the wraps and add yogurt.
dishes.why: Friday lunch needs to stand on its own, and beans give a fast protein anchor without another long cook.

dishes.name: Bean wraps for one
dishes.title: Black beans, peppers and wraps
dishes.method: Warm the beans and sweetcorn in a pan with the peppers, then fill the wraps and add yogurt.
dishes.why: A quick bean wrap lunch fits the day and keeps the table moving without the oven.

dishes.name: Lentil and veg bowl
dishes.title: Lentil tomato sauce, roasted vegetables and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil sauce, roasted vegetables and rice in a pan, then finish with parsley.
dishes.why: It keeps Thursday dinner warm and usable while the repainting makes the kitchen less convenient.

dishes.name: Lentil and veg bowl
dishes.title: Lentil tomato sauce, roasted vegetables and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil sauce, roasted vegetables and rice in a pan.
dishes.why: A simple reheated dinner keeps the plan moving and avoids extra work on a difficult evening.

dishes.name: Chicken traybake lunch
dishes.title: Chicken, courgettes and potatoes
dishes.method: Roast the potatoes and courgettes, then top with reheated chicken thighs and thyme.
dishes.why: This is the second cook day and it gives a fresh lunch without relying on anything from the broken oven last week.

dishes.name: Traybake dinner
dishes.title: Chicken, courgettes and potatoes
dishes.method: Roast the potatoes and courgettes, then serve with the chicken reheated in the pan.
dishes.why: Saturday dinner stays warm, uses the second cook day and gives a loud vegetable again.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Season the chicken thighs with oil, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper. Roast in a lined tray until cooked through, then rest and box into nine portions for the week.

preparations.title: Roasted vegetables
preparations.method: Chop the vegetables, toss with oil, oregano and salt, then roast on trays until browned and tender. Cool briefly and box into nine portions.

preparations.title: Cooked pasta
preparations.method: Boil the pasta in salted water until just tender, drain, toss with a little oil and cool quickly before boxing it into six portions.

preparations.title: Lentil tomato sauce
preparations.method: Soften the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in oil, add lentils, tomatoes, bay leaf, salt and water, then simmer until thick and saucy. Cool and box into three portions for the days that need it.

preparations.title: Cooked rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice, cook it until tender, spread it out briefly to cool, then box into same-day portions for the meals that need it.

preparations.title: Courgette frittata
preparations.method: Cook the courgettes until they lose some water, pour in the beaten eggs and cheddar, and set the mixture gently in a covered pan. Cool slightly and cut into three boxed portions.

preparations.title: Roasted chicken courgette traybake
preparations.method: Toss the potatoes and courgettes with oil, salt and thyme, roast until nearly tender, then add the chicken and finish until cooked through. Use it the same day for Saturday meals, then box three meal portions.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Put the oven on for the chicken and vegetables. While they roast, start the lentil tomato sauce on the hob. Put the pasta and rice on in separate pots, then cool and box everything as it finishes.
Make the courgette frittata in a covered pan on the hob, then cut it into portions and box it for lunch or breakfast.
Roast the potatoes and courgettes first, then add the chicken to finish in the same tray and box the portions once cooked.
